description: Defines functions related to tensor conversion and meta-information in the ATen native namespace, including aliasing checks and conversion to meta tensors.

methods.name: to_will_alias
methods.description: Checks if the tensor will alias another tensor given optional parameters for dtype, layout, device, copy, and memory format.

methods.name: to_meta
methods.description: Converts a tensor or optional tensor to a meta tensor.

methods.name: dense_to_sparse_with_mask
methods.description: Converts a dense tensor to a sparse tensor with a mask, optional layout, block size, and dense dimension specified.
